title: One of these nests has taken 1,449 food deliveries. Which?
question: Which nest belongs to a colony that has been carrying food home for 15,000 frames?
context_md:
Pre-flight for `store_in_body`, the granary-vs-replete gene (`creature-reproduction-economics.md` §5.3). A delivery writes the carried cell into the world beside the nest, and the claim under test is that this leaves a **standing larder** a birth could be paid from.

One of these worlds ran a 52-ant colony for 15,000 frames; the other never had a colony on it. Same seed, same terrain, same frame, daylight pinned so neither is at night. The ants themselves are visible in one of them - **please judge the ground, not the animals**: is there a pile of food on either nest?

If the two grounds read the same, that is the answer I am after and it is the more useful one.

items.label: colony, 15,000 frames
items.caption: 52 ants, 1,449 deliveries made to this nest

items.label: no colony
items.caption: same world, no ants ever placed
